long_description:
TRM is on a mission to build a safer world for billions of people. 

AI is extending the capability gap between attackers and defenders. The fundamental unit of scale has shifted from humans to AI tokens. 

TRM combines proprietary data, with an AI investigations platform to build a system of action for crime fighters. Think Claude CoWork for mission critical investigations. 

We believe AI scale crime deserves AI scale defense. 

Join our mission ➔ www.trmlabs.com/careers
